tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers H=0.16–0.48, whereas the target is H=23.6. A slow-horizon probe addresses the resulting genuine ambiguity about reversal and slow dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-exponential adaptation from pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows do not reliably identify slow adaptation or predict the long target horizon.
The pilot has zero s_grad and cannot identify sink dependence; the slow-horizon probe is prescribed to discriminate this mechanism.
Finer short-time measurements are less directly informative about long-horizon reversal.
The slow-horizon observations can distinguish periodic behavior from adaptation.
